verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own docs describe the official Obsidian Web Clipper, a free browser extension for highlighting pages and saving web content into your vault. That directly covers clipping pages and highlights from the browser. The Obsidian URI protocol adds a documented way to create notes from outside the app. Missing for 10: detail on article/readability extraction, supported browsers and clip templates, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the clipper works as described.
